info.name: Send Transactions API
info.description:
REST API collection for SEND_TXN_OWNER schema.
Base URL and tranId are collection variables — edit them under the Variables tab.

variable.description: Dedicated id for the metadata-driven (v2) folder so v1 and v2 examples don't collide.
A client-supplied address id used in the addr_dtl merge-and-prune demo. When the service sees an explicit id it MERGEs that row instead of generating a new UUID.

item.name: Kafka Publish
item.description:
Publishes an EventEnvelope to the Kafka topic via POST /api/publish.

Structure:
  EventEnvelope          — outer wrapper (validated: all fields @NotBlank / eventTimestamp @Positive)
    └─ eventPayload      — JSON-string of TransactionEventAxonMessage

The consumer deserialises both layers and logs every key field.
Returns 202 Accepted on success; 400 Bad Request when @Valid fails.

item.name: K1. PAYMENT_INITIATED — full payload → saves to DB

body.raw:
{
  "regulatoryRegion": "US",
  "eventSource": "AIS_SERVICE",
  "eventName": "PAYMENT_INITIATED",
  "eventId": "EVT-PAY-001",
  "correlationId": "CORL-PAY-001",
  "eventTimestamp": 1731660600000,
  "eventMetadata": "{\"operation\":\"A\",\"timestamp\":\"2025-02-04T12:30:00Z\"}",
  "eventPayload": "{\"tranId\":\"TXN-PAY-001\",\"tranAmt\":\"1500.00\",\"tranAmtCurr\":\"USD\",\"status\":\"PENDING\",\"internalStatus\":\"INITIATED\",\"networkCode\":\"MASTERCARD\",\"networkResponseCode\":\"00\",\"networkResponseCodeDesc\":\"Approved\",\"correlationId\":\"CORL-PAY-001\",\"originatingInstId\":\"BANK-US-001\",\"originatingInstName\":\"First National Bank\",\"acctNum\":\"4111111111111111\",\"acctType\":\"CREDIT\",\"accountHolderName\":\"JOHN A SMITH\",\"sndrAcct\":\"ACC-001234\",\"rcvrAcct\":\"ACC-005678\",\"cvcStatus\":\"PASS\",\"cvcResponseCode\":\"M\",\"nameStatus\":\"MATCH\",\"fundAvailable\":\"Y\",\"channel\":\"API\",\"paymentRef\":\"PAYREF-20241115-001\",\"paymentUnqRefNum\":\"UTR-ABCDEF123456\",\"paymentSetlAmt\":\"1500.00\",\"fundingSource\":\"CHECKING\",\"merchantCategoryCd\":\"5411\",\"paymentType\":\"CARD\",\"originalRequestPayload\":\"{\\\"amount\\\":1500}\",\"originalResponsePayload\":\"{\\\"status\\\":\\\"approved\\\"}\",\"transferAccptName\":\"ACME RETAIL INC\",\"transferAccptId\":\"MERCH-9876\",\"transferAccptAddrLn1\":\"789 Broadway\",\"transferAccptAddrCity\":\"New York\",\"transferAccptAddrState\":\"NY\",\"transferAccptAddrCntry\":\"USA\",\"transferAccptAddrPostalCd\":\"10001\",\"processorId\":\"PROC-001\",\"sndrFirstName\":\"John\",\"sndrMiddleName\":\"A\",\"sndrLastName\":\"Smith\",\"sndrPhoneNum\":\"+12125550101\",\"sndrEmailAddr\":\"john.smith@example.com\",\"sndrBirthDt\":\"1985-06-20\",\"sndrNationalityCd\":\"US\",\"sndrAcct\":\"ACC-001234\",\"sndrAddrLine1\":\"123 Main St\",\"sndrCityName\":\"New York\",\"sndrCountryCd\":\"US\",\"sndrPostalCd\":\"10001\",\"rcvrFirstName\":\"Jane\",\"rcvrLastName\":\"Doe\",\"rcvrPhoneNum\":\"+14155550199\",\"rcvrEmailAddr\":\"jane.doe@example.com\",\"rcvrBirthDate\":\"1990-03-14\",\"rcvrNationalityCd\":\"MX\",\"rcvrAcct\":\"ACC-005678\",\"rcvrAddrLine1\":\"456 Reforma Ave\",\"rcvrCity\":\"Mexico City\",\"rcvrCountryCd\":\"MX\",\"rcvrPostalCd\":\"06600\"}"

request.description:
PAYMENT_INITIATED event → matched by PAYMENT.yaml → canonical mapping applied → saved to SEND_TRANSACTIONS + SEND_TRAN_DTL + SEND_RECIP_DTL + SEND_TRAN_ADDR_DTL.

Expect logs:
  [CONSUMER] Matched mapping eventType=PAYMENT
  [CONSUMER] Canonical request built | tranId=TXN-PAY-001 tranType=SEND
  [CONSUMER] Saved to DB successfully

item.name: K2. PAYMENT_COMPLETED — status update (re-upsert same tranId)

request.description: Same tranId=TXN-PAY-001 re-upserted with status=COMPLETED. The MERGE null-guard preserves all fields already in DB that are absent from this payload.
PAYMENT_FAILED event creates TXN-PAY-002 with status=FAILED, error ERR-5001, network response 51.

item.name: K4. FUNDING_INITIATED — full funding payload → saves to DB

request.description:
FUNDING_INITIATED event → matched by FUNDING.yaml → tranIdSource=fundingId → DB key=FUND-001, tranType=FUNDING.

Expect logs:
  [CONSUMER] Matched mapping eventType=FUNDING
  [CONSUMER] Canonical request built | tranId=FUND-001 tranType=FUNDING
  [CONSUMER] Saved to DB successfully
Re-upserts FUND-001 with fundingStatus=SETTLED. Null-guard preserves all previously saved fields.

item.name: K6. ignore=true — skipped by consumer (no DB write)

request.description: ignore=true stops the consumer after logging the envelope. No mapping or DB write occurs.

item.name: K7. Unknown eventName — no mapping (warning logged, no DB write)

request.description:
eventName=UNKNOWN_EVENT_TYPE has no YAML mapping. Consumer logs a WARN and skips DB write.

To handle this event: add 'UNKNOWN_EVENT_TYPE' to the eventNames list of an existing YAML, or create a new UNKNOWN_EVENT_TYPE.yaml.

item.name: K8. 400 — Validation failure (missing required envelope fields)

request.description: Missing eventName, eventId, correlationId, eventMetadata, eventPayload (@NotBlank) and eventTimestamp (@Positive defaults 0). Expects 400 with field-level validation errors.

item.name: K9. BLOCKED — eventSource not in allowedEventSources (PAYMENT)

request.description:
eventSource=UNKNOWN_SOURCE is NOT in PAYMENT.yaml allowedEventSources=[AIS_SERVICE, PAYMENT_HUB].

Rule engine fires at Step 4 (after routing, before payload deserialization).

Expect logs:
  [CONSUMER]  Matched mapping | eventType=PAYMENT
  [RULE ENGINE] IGNORED | rule=eventSource | value='UNKNOWN_SOURCE' | allowed=[AIS_SERVICE, PAYMENT_HUB]
  [CONSUMER]  Message blocked by rule engine

No DB write. Returns 202 to the publisher (Kafka is fire-and-forget).

item.name: K10. BLOCKED — operation not in allowedOperations (PAYMENT)

request.description:
eventSource=AIS_SERVICE passes Rule 1. But operation=D is NOT in PAYMENT.yaml allowedOperations=[A, U].

Rule engine fires at Step 4, Rule 2.

Expect logs:
  [CONSUMER]  Matched mapping | eventType=PAYMENT
  [RULE ENGINE] IGNORED | rule=operation | value='D' | allowed=[A, U]
  [CONSUMER]  Message blocked by rule engine

No DB write. Compare with FUNDING.yaml which DOES allow operation=D.

item.name: K11. RECTIFIED — malformed payload fixed and saved to DB

request.description:
eventPayload uses single quotes and has a trailing comma — both are not valid in strict JSON.

Sanitizer fires at Step 5:
  Attempt 1 (as-is)      → FAIL  (not valid strict JSON)
  Attempt 2 (trim)       → FAIL  (still invalid)
  Attempt 3 (unwrap)     → FAIL  (doesn't start with '"')
  Attempt 4 (lenient)    → PASS  → re-emits strict RFC-8259 JSON

Expect logs:
  [SANITIZER] eventPayload is not valid JSON — starting rectification attempts
  [SANITIZER] Rectified ✓ | strategy=LENIENT_RESERIALIZE
  [CONSUMER]  Canonical request built | tranId=TXN-SAN-001
  [CONSUMER]  Saved to DB successfully

item.name: K12. IRRECOVERABLE — truly invalid payload, message skipped

body.raw:
{
  "regulatoryRegion": "US",
  "eventSource": "AIS_SERVICE",
  "eventName": "PAYMENT_INITIATED",
  "eventId": "EVT-SAN-002",
  "correlationId": "CORL-SAN-002",
  "eventTimestamp": 1731660600000,
  "eventMetadata": "{\"operation\":\"A\",\"timestamp\":\"2025-02-04T12:30:00Z\"}",
  "eventPayload": "THIS IS NOT JSON AT ALL *** CORRUPT PAYLOAD ***"
}

request.description:
eventPayload is plain text — no rectification strategy can recover it.

Sanitizer fires at Step 5:
  Attempt 1 (as-is)      → FAIL
  Attempt 2 (trim)       → FAIL
  Attempt 3 (unwrap)     → FAIL  (doesn't start with '"')
  Attempt 4 (lenient)    → FAIL  (not parseable even leniently)

Expect logs:
  [SANITIZER] eventPayload is not valid JSON — starting rectification attempts
  [SANITIZER] eventPayload is irrecoverable — message will be skipped. Preview: THIS IS NOT JSON...
  [CONSUMER]  eventPayload is invalid and cannot be rectified — skipping

No DB write. Returns 202 to the publisher (Kafka is fire-and-forget).

item.name: Metadata-Driven (v2) API
item.description:
Tests for the new generic, YAML-metadata-driven endpoints at /api/v2/*.

The routes are:
  PUT    /api/v2/{alias}/{id}    upsert (parent + children if alias is a root table)
  GET    /api/v2/{alias}/{id}    fetch with nested children
  GET    /api/v2/{alias}         paginated parent rows (no children)
  DELETE /api/v2/{alias}/{id}    cascade-delete
  GET    /api/v2/_metadata       list all loaded tables
  GET    /api/v2/_metadata/{alias}   describe one table

Aliases come from the YAML files under src/main/resources/metadata/:
  send-transactions  send-tran-dtl  send-recip-dtl  send-tran-addr-dtl

Adding a new column = one line in YAML + DDL change. No Java changes.

request.description: Returns the column metadata for every loaded YAML. Mitigation for loss-of-Swagger after the move to Map<String,Object> payloads.
Returns the columns, child references, audit/CLOB/converter flags for a single table — useful for client codegen or API doc generation.
Look for clob:true on bncGtwyRqst / bncGtwyResp / origRqstPyld / origRespPyld.
Inserts the parent only. The response is a JSON Map (not a typed POJO) shaped from the metadata column list.

request.description:
Demonstrates every special case in one call:
  - CLOB via clob:true → TO_CLOB CASE WHEN (bncGtwyRqst, bncGtwyResp, origRqstPyld, origRespPyld, sendGovtIdUri)
  - DATE round-trip (sendDob, recipDob)
  - NUMBER(1,0) ↔ Boolean via converter:BOOLEAN_AS_INT (nonFinTxn: true)
  - 1:1 child upsert (tranDtl, recipDtl)
  - 1:many child MERGE with one client-supplied id (addrDtl[0]) and one auto-UUID (addrDtl[1])
  - Audit columns SYSTIMESTAMP-populated server-side

Run the GET request next to see the full nested graph reflected back.

item.name: v2-U3. Null-guard demo (only tranAmt updated, others preserved)

request.description:
Run AFTER v2-U2.

Sends explicit nulls for curStat and ntwrkCd. The generated MERGE uses COALESCE(:p, t.COL) — so the existing non-null values in the DB (curStat=COMPLETED, ntwrkCd=MASTERCARD from v2-U2) survive. Only tranAmt changes.

Required fields (tranCrteDt, tranType) must still be sent because metadata validator enforces required on every upsert.

Writes ~1.5 KB into the CLOB column BNC_GTWY_RQST via the auto-generated  CASE WHEN :p IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CLOB(:p) ELSE t.COL END  pattern. The parameter is bound as Types.VARCHAR — Oracle promotes it to CLOB.

GET v2-Q1 should return the same string verbatim.

item.name: v2-U5. addr_dtl merge-and-prune (keep id-001, drop the other)

body.raw:
{
  "tranType": "SEND",

  "nonFinTxn": false,

    {

      "stLine1": "123 Main St — UPDATED via merge",
      "city": "New York",
      "st": "NY",
      "cntryNam": "US",
      "postCd": "10001",
      "addrStat": "VERIFIED",
      "updtUserNam": "merge-test"
    }
  ]
}

request.description:
Run AFTER v2-U2 (which created 2 addresses, one with explicit id={{addrIdV2}}, one auto-UUID).

This request sends only the explicit-id address. The service:
  1. MERGEs the explicit-id row (updates stLine1)
  2. Collects keepIds = [{{addrIdV2}}]
  3. DELETEs every other address for this tranId NOT IN keepIds — so the auto-UUID one is removed.

A following GET will show exactly 1 address.

item.name: v2-U6. addr_dtl empty list → delete all

request.description: Empty array semantics: every SEND_TRAN_ADDR_DTL row for this tranId is deleted. A following GET will show addrDtl: [].
When tranDtl / recipDtl / addrDtl keys are absent (not just null) the service leaves those child rows alone. Use the GET that follows to confirm the existing children survive.

item.name: v2-Q1. GET by ID - Full Graph

request.description:
Response is a Map<String,Object> assembled from the YAML metadata:
  - parent columns at the root
  - tranDtl   → nested Map (or null)
  - recipDtl  → nested Map (or null)
  - addrDtl   → array of Maps

Field order follows the YAML column order (LinkedHashMap).
Paginated parent-only list (no child data). Same PagedResponse shape as v1, with first/last flags.
Validated by @Min(0) on page and @Min(1)@Max(100) on size.

item.name: Direct Child-Table Access
item.description: Because every table is registered with its own alias, child tables are addressable on their own — useful for ops queries and partial updates that don't need to walk through the parent.

request.description: SEND_TRAN_DTL has PK = FK = TRAN_ID. The {id} path variable is the tranId.
Returns the SEND_RECIP_DTL row (sender + recipient PII, DOBs as ISO yyyy-MM-dd).

item.name: v2-C3. GET single address by its UUID

request.description: SEND_TRAN_ADDR_DTL has a per-row PK (ID). Use the id returned in v2-Q1's addrDtl[] array. The collection variable {{addrIdV2}} is set to the fixed id used in v2-U2.

item.name: v2-C4. PATCH a single address directly (null-guard)

request.description: Direct child-row MERGE. Only addrStat + updtUserNam change; all other fields are preserved by the COALESCE null-guard. Note: tranId (FK) and id (PK) are required by the metadata so they must be sent.
Service-side cascade: addrDtl → tranDtl → recipDtl → parent (because the DDL has no ON DELETE CASCADE). Returns 204.
MetadataValidator enforces required:true from YAML. Same 400 JSON shape (fieldErrors map) as v1's @NotBlank failure — the global handler treats them identically.
Expect 400 with fieldErrors.tranCrteDt = "must not be null".
tranType is VARCHAR2(10) in DDL and maxLength:10 in YAML. Expect 400 with fieldErrors.tranType = "must not exceed 10 characters". No DB call is made.

item.name: v2-E4. 400 - Child tranDtl missing required tranCrteDt

request.description: Validation runs per section. Expect 400 on the child's required:true tranCrteDt field.
Bean Validation on the controller, not metadata-driven. Returns 400 with ConstraintViolationException shape.
Returns 404 with the same ErrorResponse shape (UTC timestamp + traceId from MDC) as v1.

MetadataRegistry.require throws IllegalArgumentException for an unknown alias. Caught by the generic exception handler — 500 with a masked message ("An unexpected error occurred"). Real error visible in server logs.
